# Test verbose output flag

# Initialize git repo
exec git init
exec git config user.name "Test User"
exec git config user.email "test@example.com"

# Create main branch
exec git checkout -b main  
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'main commit'

# Create feature branch with fewer lines
exec git checkout -b feature
cp short.txt content.txt
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feature commit'

# Test with verbose flag - just verify success message still appears
exec ratchet --verbose --lt main 'wc -l < content.txt'
stdout 'Success: HEAD metric \(2\) is less than main \(5\)'

# Test without verbose flag
exec ratchet --lt main 'wc -l < content.txt'
stdout 'Success: HEAD metric \(2\) is less than main \(5\)'

-- content.txt --
line 1
line 2
line 3
line 4
line 5
-- short.txt --
line 1
line 2
